name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She stands with the staff planted and her free hand open toward the sky, her gown and hair lifted by a rising wind of petals, chin lifted, a serene, radiant gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.expression: a calm, knowing smile, eyes gentle and patient.
components.effects: Roots and flowering vines surge up around her, petals, leaves and glowing {{MAGIC}} spores swirl in a great spiral, the heart-tree's boughs bloom all at once and shafts of golden light pour down.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Sylvanya, rising close behind her among the boughs with its wings spread like canopies, emerald-green and forest-sage scales, trailing drifting leaves and spores, wings like broad canopy leaves veined in moss-gold

notes: HOLO edition 'Heart of the Grove': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
